BiblicalUsage: Mylon is a mill-house, the place of grinding — two women shall be grinding at the mill, the one shall be taken, and the other left. In the Greek text behind the King James Version the mill-house stands where the later text reads the millstone's mill, and this study follows the King James reading.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mill is the picture of ordinary life interrupted: two women grinding together, and one taken, and the readiness that makes the difference.
RelatedTopics: Waiting on God; Second Coming; Judgment
